ValidationRule.description: Validation to check Work Phone is entered in a correct format.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, NOT(CONTAINS( $User.Username,$Label.UnicaIntegrationUserName)), NOT(CONTAINS( $User.Username,$Label.AdobeIntegrationUserName)), OR( AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = 'CCRM_Lead',Text(Status) != 'Outcome',Text(Lead_Outcome__c) != 'Expired'), AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = 'MLCRM_Lead',Text(Status) != 'Expired', OR(ISNEW(),ISCHANGED(Work_Phone__c)) ) ), NOT ISBLANK(Work_Phone__c) , NOT REGEX(Work_Phone__c , "^\\+61[0-9]{9}+$" ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Work Phone entered is not in the correct format. Refer to help text.
